confidence_notes: FX comes from an RBA search result: the 19 Nov 2026 USD per AUD rate in the RBA statistics table. I did not open the page myself. Food and drink anchors rest on one search of crowd-sourced cost-of-living sites, which gave about A$10 for a beer, A$6.4 for a cappuccino and A$24 for an inexpensive meal. Those sites show some variation between snapshots. I made no searches for cocktails or wine, so I estimated them from the beer price: cocktail about 1.7 times beer and wine glass about 1.6 times beer. The mid-range meal for two is an estimate. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. Cairns is a tourist hub, so prices swing with season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Brisbane and other regional Queensland tourist cities, using the Cairns versus Brisbane comparison from the cost-of-living sites. Accommodation is based on general knowledge of Queensland tropical tourism markets.
